---
title: "The data dictionary, browsable"
---

opus's yaml dictionaries describe every field across HH, HL, CA, and LT — type, unit, valid
range or code list, and (where the data profile below shows it's worth a
second look) an evidence-linked `todo`. Embedded below: a relationship
diagram, a searchable field index, and a live profile of each column's
real values, generated directly from the shipped dictionary and the full
local DATRAS archive via [data-dict](https://data-dict.tidyverse.org/)'s
own `render` command.

::: {.callout-important}
## This is a dated snapshot, not a live page
Unlike the yaml itself, this render isn't rebuilt automatically — the
underlying archive it profiles against keeps growing as new DATRAS years
land, and isn't part of this repository. Treat the date below as the
"as of," not a promise of continuous freshness.
:::

**Snapshot as of 2026-08-29** (HH/HL/CA/LT coverage complete):

```{=html}
<iframe src="dictionary-snapshot-2026-08-29.html"
        style="width:100%; height:85vh; border:1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius:4px;"
        title="opus data dictionary, rendered by data-dict"></iframe>
```

Feels cramped? Open it on its own:
[dictionary-snapshot-2026-08-29.html](dictionary-snapshot-2026-08-29.html).

To regenerate at a later milestone:
`opus::op_render_spec(data_dir = ".datras/to_https/raw")`,
saved under a new dated filename here rather than overwriting this one —
so which snapshot is current stays visible, not hidden.

Raw yaml, if you want the machine-readable version directly:
[`DATRAS-data-dict.yaml`](https://github.com/einarhjorleifsson/opus/blob/main/inst/DATRAS-data-dict.yaml)
